utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, sorry I'm late—did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh really? I thought it was still Saturday—I've got all my tools prepped. Guess I'll have to shuffle my weekend plans.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sorry for the late notice—I only just found out myself. Sunday afternoon at the community center, should be good.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Just a heads-up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks for letting me know — Sunday works better for me anyway.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good, I'm glad that works for you. I've already let a few others know about the change.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Mara, I'm not sure yet. I still haven't heard enough details to commit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I'm in the same boat, Mina. I just got wind of it myself—what exactly are we fixing up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, do you know who's organizing this thing? I'd feel better if I knew who was in charge.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right, it's repairs only. If Saturday doesn't work, there's another one next month.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought it was on Sunday at the community center? Did you say Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday, 10 am. Check the flyer on the community board if you need to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, I just ran into Dane—he was saying the repair drive's alignment is a real headache. You heard anything new about it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yeah, Ira—the drive actually got moved to Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday. Hope that makes the alignment easier!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks for the heads-up, Tess—Sunday works better for me anyway. I'll see if I can round up some folks to help with the roof.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about it, but I'm not sure on the details. You got any info?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's this Saturday—folks are fixing up homes around the block. I've got a good set of wrenches if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday, got it. I might drop by if I can squeeze it in between errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Sounds familiar... is that the one where we bring broken stuff to the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not entirely sure either, Oren. I thought it was for fixing small appliances, but I've heard different things.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, small appliances! I vaguely recall someone mentioning toasters and such... Hana asked me about calibration too, but I can't quite remember what she meant.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, hi Faye! Yes, the repair drive shouldn't interfere with school pickup—it's all set for Saturday, so tomorrow's schedule is fine.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, Mara, I just heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, so tomorrow's pickup is safe either way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Ah, thanks for the update, Faye! Sunday works for me, I'll make a note of it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, this Saturday? I'll need to check my schedule—did they say what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, good news, Pia—it's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center. We're starting at 9 AM, so there's still plenty of time to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Sunday works better for me, but 9 AM is still early—will there be enough people to handle both the electronics and the roof work?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam! Have you heard about the repair drive Opal's organizing? They've set up bins in the community center basement.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh yeah, I heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center. Need any help hauling stuff or sorting tools?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That's great to hear! Yes, any help would be awesome—I'll be there on Sunday too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just so you know, Kira, the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center — I've got my tools all set and ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, moved to Sunday? I hadn't even heard about a repair drive in the first place. Who told you that?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam told me about the change, clear as day. Sorry if you missed the word—happens fast around here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Hana, I've been telling everyone about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center! Have you heard about it yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I've heard a few mentions of it, but I'm still not clear on what exactly it's for. Is it the one that needs special calibration?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, that's the one! It's all about fixing up old appliances and electronics — and don't worry, we'll have some folks who know their way around a multimeter.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sam, I'm still unsure—are we talking about the same drive that needs special calibration, or is this something different?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, it's the same one — just moved to Sunday at the community center. I can help with calibration if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — I just wanted to be sure it was the same one. I've heard it can be tricky, so I might take you up on that help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Faye, what do you think about this repair drive for the playground?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Actually, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, so it won't mess with school pickups at all.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That's good to know — but do you think the new location will actually bring in more volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I'll be there for a bit. Got a few things to look at.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, is it Saturday or Sunday? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's on Saturday, from noon till late afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great, Oren! The tarps could be really useful. Let me know what you find, and I'll add you to the volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I'll go dig through the garage — I think I've got a couple of tarps in there somewhere, unless I used them for that old barbecue cover project.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ha, that barbecue cover project was a saga! But no worries, just let me know if you find them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Jules, you've got to come to the repair drive this weekend! We'll be fixing stuff and sipping coffee—it's the perfect way to meet everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Quinn! I love the idea of mixing repairs with good coffee—count me in, and I'll spread the word to the folks I know too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Fantastic, Jules! The more hands the merrier. I'll see you there bright and early—coffee's on me!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center? Still happening, just a different day and spot!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I caught that too—Sunday at the community center, that's what I heard. Sorry I'm late again, by the way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No worries, Dane! I figure better late than never, right? So you all set for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I heard about the repair drive. Let's make sure we coordinate the drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's not a drop-off for donations; bring broken appliances to the community center this Saturday for repair.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wait, so we're supposed to bring our items on Saturday, not beforehand? I need to check if the community center has enough space for everyone's things.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Rey, just so you know, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Sunday at the community center — I guess I had it mixed up before. Thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yeah, it's a last-minute change, but I've already let everyone know—should still be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Vik, I've been hearing bits about a repair drive. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Nell! Yeah, the repair drive is this Saturday — they're collecting broken electronics at the community center, and folks like Mara are getting ready to fix them up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds interesting! Do you know what kind of electronics they're looking for?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard from Sam. Sunday at the community center—I’ll be there with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Eli! We'll be glad to have your tools and expertise.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey there, Kira! I heard from Vik that the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center—sounds like a great chance to get stuff fixed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure you heard right? I haven't seen any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Vik mentioned it to me, so it must be legit. He's usually in the loop.
